data: Zenodo 18706837 version1; 35 participant folders, 32 with wearable records
population: all35 original IDs, no outcome-based participant selection
endpoint: unchanged configs/daily_protocol.json; 56day reference/32day history/1day gap/7day future; >=2 abnormal families

state_mapping.hrv: rmssd,low_frequency,high_frequency daily mean and population SD, >=4 recorded intervals with coverage>0; all six belong to HRV family
state_mapping.sleep: overall_score and deep_sleep_in_minutes daily means; one sleep family
state_mapping.self-report: completed questionnaire stress and anxiety, grouped by actual local completion day; one self-report family

context_mapping: daily step sum; fractions of four recorded activity levels; registered-class scheduled minutes from released course calendar
omitted_fields: SpO2 omitted as a modality because the paper documents pervasive measurement artifacts without a quality flag; proprietary Fitbit stress omitted because it recombines other physiological inputs
timestamps: explicit-Z Fitbit timestamps converted to the participant's first recorded timezone offset; naive HRV timestamps retained as source-local; questionnaires use Unix seconds plus row timezone offset; all daily values available at end of their assigned day
availability_scope: replay of device-side records, not the monthly investigator-upload times; actual server delivery times are absent
aggregation: duplicate rows removed; duplicate timestamps averaged for numeric measurements; no interpolation; daily grid from first to last recorded sensor/questionnaire day; measured zeros retained
source_model_selection: original HNE source models reused; pooled HGB uses same .01/.1/1 C grid and source fivefold/domain-balanced selection; no SSAQS fitting or threshold tuning
comparison_scope: frozen-source transfer with differing sensor semantics and variable context counts
